description: This file defines functions and data structures for creating and benchmarking various RNN/LSTM models, including factory functions for different configurations of LSTM, their backward setup, and interaction with Torch modules. It includes specific implementations for models used in performance benchmarking within the project.

methods.name: flatten_list(lst)
methods.description: Flattens a list of lists into a single list.

methods.name: lstm_backward_setup(lstm_outputs, seed=None)
methods.description: Sets up the backward pass for LSTM outputs, optionally seeding with a random tensor.

methods.name: simple_backward_setup(output, seed=None)
methods.description: Prepares gradients for backward pass using random tensor.

methods.name: pytorch_lstm_creator(**kwargs)
methods.description: Creates a ModelDef for a standard PyTorch LSTM module with specified configuration.

methods.name: lstm_creator(script=True, **kwargs)
methods.description: Creates a ModelDef for a custom LSTM model with specified configuration.

methods.name: lnlstm_creator(script=True, decompose_layernorm=False, **kwargs)
methods.description: Creates a ModelDef for a scripted LayerNorm LSTM, mimicking cudnn's forward pass for benchmarking.

methods.name: dropoutlstm_creator(script=True, **kwargs)
methods.description: Creates a ModelDef for an LSTM with dropout, using custom lstm module.

methods.name: lstm_premul_creator(script=True, **kwargs)
methods.description: Creates a ModelDef for an LSTM with premultiplied inputs and weights.

methods.name: lstm_premul_bias_creator(script=True, **kwargs)
methods.description: Creates a ModelDef for an LSTM with premultiplied inputs, weights, and biases.

methods.name: lstm_simple_creator(script=True, **kwargs)
methods.description: Creates a simple flat-input LSTM ModelDef for benchmarking.

methods.name: lstm_multilayer_creator(script=True, **kwargs)
methods.description: Creates a multilayer LSTM ModelDef for benchmarking.

methods.name: imagenet_cnn_creator(arch, jit=True)
methods.description: Creates a ModelDef for a torchvision ImageNet model, optionally traced with JIT.

methods.name: varlen_lstm_inputs( minlen=30, maxlen=100, numLayers=1, inputSize=512, hiddenSize=512, miniBatch=64, return_module=False, device="cuda", seed=None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Generates variable-length sequence inputs, initial states, and optional module for variable-length LSTM benchmarking.

methods.name: varlen_lstm_backward_setup(forward_output, seed=None)
methods.description: Setup for backward pass in variable-length sequence LSTM, including padding and gradients.

methods.name: varlen_pytorch_lstm_creator(**kwargs)
methods.description: Creates a ModelDef for variable-length sequence LSTM using PyTorch’s built-in utils.

methods.name: varlen_lstm_factory(cell, script)
methods.description: Creates a scripted dynamic RNN function for variable-length sequences using specified cell.

methods.name: varlen_lstm_creator(script=False, **kwargs)
methods.description: Creates a ModelDef for variable-length sequence LSTM with custom RNN logic.

methods.name: layernorm_pytorch_lstm_creator(**kwargs)
methods.description: Creates a ModelDef for a LayerNorm-mimicking, scripted LSTM benchmark model.

methods.name: stack_weights(weights)
methods.description: Transforms a list of weights into a packed format suitable for certain LSTM implementations.

methods.name: lstm_inputs( seqLength=100, numLayers=1, inputSize=512, hiddenSize=512, miniBatch=64, dropout=0.0, return_module=False, device="cuda", seed=None, )
methods.description: Provides initial inputs, states, and weights for a standard LSTM, optionally returning the module.

methods.name: lstm_factory_premul_bias(premul_cell, script)
methods.description: Creates a dynamic RNN with premultiplied inputs, weights, and biases, optionally scripted.

methods.name: lstm_factory_simple(cell, script)
methods.description: Creates a non-recurrent, flat-input version of dynamic RNN for benchmarking
